Order of Ancients (Footmen Frenzy Standalone) Kickstarter!

Hai everyone. I'm John Pan, just a small piece of the awesome team that's making this game. If anyone harks back to the Warcraft III days and wants to help revive an age-old classic custom map called Footmen Frenzy, check out our Kickstarter! I'm actually a Starcraft 2 kinda guy so a lot of our inspiration and mechanics will draw from SC2 as well! They don't know this yet, but I'm secretly pushing the game towards the direction of Marine Arena.

While I'm really stoked about the general idea of the game since I love footies, what exactly will the finished product be like? As in, how much footie will it be? I'd be willing something that keeps the core gameplay of footies, but if it's pushed in the direction of Marine Arena or dips too much into SC2, I'd rather pass.

We were actually just discussing this. We plan to have several game modes but the main ranked mode will follow footies' gameplay to stay true to its origins. A lot of the mechanics will be developed to be more action-focused so that controlling units feels like art.

Wow, this is definitely an elegant and cool solution. I just hope you guys introduce better micro options for controlling the footies. It was a chore moving a stacked army back in the days because of the unit selection limit.

Definitely. I've got set up a selection system that maxes out at 512 units in a selection. Auto-selections (i.e. All units, all heros, all mercenaries, etc.) will be included with the standard control group selections.

I'm not the best of speakers, but I like to upload development updates on Youtube from time to time. Unit movement will look something like this. I plan to make pulling back damaged units and maneuvering units within an army as comfortable as possible. Everything will be designed around player intent.

Btw, I started up the War3 campaign recently and really noticed the iffyness of controlling an army beyond just the limited selections. Units were blocking each other mid-combat and taking a long time to get into their formations... None of those problems will exist in Order.
Not to put you down but why would anyone want to play this over footmen frenzy in a dota 2 or wc3?

The main reason I can think of is freedom and the features that come along with it. As a standalone, every piece and mechanic can be custom-made for Order of Ancients. A ranking system, epic skins, and gameplay mechanics tailored for micro-intensive army battles are a few of the things we can do with a standalone that can't be done easily in Dota 2 or War3.
